assertions.subject: Abscess
assertions.quote: Palpation of fluctuance in the setting of localized erythema and effusion suggests the presence of an abscess

assertions.subject: Abscess
assertions.predicate: failure to resolve with antibiotic treatment
assertions.quote: The existence of an abscess may also be suggested by the failure of apparent cellulitis to resolve upon initiation of antibiotic treatment

assertions.subject: Paronychia
assertions.predicate: erythema, swelling, and effusion of the lateral nail fold
assertions.quote: Erythema, swelling, and effusion of the lateral or proximal nail fold indicate paronychia or eponychia, respectively

assertions.subject: Eponychia
assertions.predicate: erythema, swelling, and effusion of the proximal nail fold
assertions.quote: Erythema, swelling, and effusion of the lateral or proximal nail fold indicate paronychia or eponychia, respectively

assertions.subject: Felon
assertions.predicate: erythema, effusion, and pain in the pulp of the fingertip
assertions.quote: Erythema, effusion, and pain in the pulp of the fingertip may represent the presence of a felon

assertions.subject: Herpetic whitlow
assertions.predicate: digital pain and erythema in the setting of clustered vesicles
assertions.quote: A herpetic whitlow is oftentimes signified by digital pain and erythema in the setting of clustered vesicles that coalesce together over time

assertions.subject: Gas gangrene or necrotizing soft tissue infection
assertions.quote: Noting the presence of crepitation may suggest an infection with a gas-forming microorganism, and should raise suspicion for gas gangrene or a necrotizing soft tissue infection

assertions.subject: Flexor tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: Presence of some or all of Kanavel’s cardinal signs (flexor posturing and fusiform swelling of the digit, tenderness to palpation along the flexor tendon sheath, and pain upon passive digit extension) may indicate the presence of flexor tenosynovitis

assertions.subject: Flexor tenosynovitis

assertions.subject: Septic arthritis
assertions.predicate: pain, erythema, and effusion of any of the joints of the hand or wrist
assertions.quote: Septic arthritis may be signified by pain, erythema, and effusion of any of the joints of the hand or wrist, with significant pain upon passive or active range of motion

assertions.subject: Osteomyelitis
assertions.predicate: localized erythema, bony pain, and edema
assertions.quote: A patient with osteomyelitis oftentimes has risk factors predisposing them to this condition, and on a physical exam may demonstrate localized erythema, bony pain, and edema

assertions.subject: Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: In some cases of osteomyelitis, a draining sinus tract will also be present
